<xform:editShow><script>function lengthAdvice(element,message,visible){var advice;var wrapped=$(element);if(!wrapped.next().next()||wrapped.next().next().length<1){advice=document.createElement("div");advice.setAttribute("class","validation-advice");advice.textContent=message;wrapped.parent().append(advice);}else{advice=wrapped.next().next()[0];}if(visible){$(advice).show();}else{$(advice).hide();}} AttachXFormValueChangeEventById("fd_number",function(input,element){if(!input||input.length<1){return;}element.value=input.replace(/\D/g,'');var showAdvice=false;if(element.value.length<16){showAdvice=true;}lengthAdvice(element,"卡号长度为16-19位，请注意检查!",showAdvice);});</script></xform:editShow>
